SKELETON_WARRIOR.name: Skeleton Warrior
SKELETON_WARRIOR.lore: Chipped sword, missing ribs, unlimited enthusiasm. Rattles when nervous, which is always.

FIRE_IMP.name: Fire Imp
FIRE_IMP.lore: Small, hot-headed and legally banned from three bakeries.

FROST_BAT.name: Frost Bat
FROST_BAT.lore: Hangs upside down until its feet freeze to the ceiling. Then just hangs.

PUMPKINLING.name: Pumpkinling
PUMPKINLING.lore: Not carved yet and very worried about October 31st.

VOLT_GHOST.name: Volt Ghost
VOLT_GHOST.lore: Haunts power lines. Its favourite word is 'BZZT'.

HAUNTED_ARMOR.name: Haunted Armor
HAUNTED_ARMOR.lore: Nobody home. The polish, however, is immaculate.

FLAME_SKULL.name: Flame Skull
FLAME_SKULL.lore: A skull that kept its fiery personality and nothing else.

SCARECROW.name: Scarecrow
SCARECROW.lore: Scares crows, villagers and the occasional mirror.

SHIELD_SKELETON.name: Shield Skeleton
SHIELD_SKELETON.lore: Its whole strategy is the shield. It has also lost the sword.

STEAM_SLIME.name: Steam Slime
STEAM_SLIME.lore: Half lava, half ice, all sauna.

JACK_O_LANTERN.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
JACK_O_LANTERN.lore: The pumpkinling who got carved and took it personally.

BOG_WITCH.name: Bog Witch
BOG_WITCH.lore: Brews soup from frogs, moss and the last hunter who asked for a recipe.

STORM_BANSHEE.name: Storm Banshee
STORM_BANSHEE.lore: Her wail comes with thunder, frost and an unpaid electricity bill.

TESLA_SPIDER.name: Tesla Spider
TESLA_SPIDER.lore: Eight legs, one coil, zero respect for wiring codes.

WISP.name: Wisp
WISP.lore: Whatever was left over. Glows in the colour of your bad roll.

HEADLESS_HORSEMAN.name: Headless Horseman
HEADLESS_HORSEMAN.lore: Lost his head, kept the horse, found a pumpkin. Fair trade.

STITCHED_GOLEM.name: Stitched Golem
STITCHED_GOLEM.lore: Assembled from spare parts and powered by a very confused thundercloud.

WITCH_QUEEN.name: Witch Queen
WITCH_QUEEN.lore: Rules a court of crows. The crows did not vote.

CLOCKWORK_KRAKEN.name: Clockwork Kraken
CLOCKWORK_KRAKEN.lore: Wound up in a boiler room, it now winds up everyone else.

LICH.name: Lich
LICH.lore: Kept his soul in a jar. Then labelled the jar 'pickles'. Nobody suspects a thing.

HELLHOUND.name: Hellhound
HELLHOUND.lore: Good boy. Very good boy. Please do not pet the fire.

FROST_WRAITH.name: Frost Wraith
FROST_WRAITH.lore: Drifts in with the first frost and steals the warmth from your tea.

MANDRAKE_BRUTE.name: Mandrake Brute
MANDRAKE_BRUTE.lore: Screams when pulled from the ground. Screams louder when pulled from a fight.

THUNDER_GHOUL.name: Thunder Ghoul
THUNDER_GHOUL.lore: Eats lightning for breakfast and storms for lunch. Dinner is you.

GARGOYLE.name: Gargoyle
GARGOYLE.lore: Sat on a church roof for 300 years. Has opinions about the bells.

BONE_DRAGON.name: Bone Dragon
BONE_DRAGON.lore: Every bone in the graveyard answered the call. Some arrived as wings.

EMBER_COLOSSUS.name: Ember Colossus
EMBER_COLOSSUS.lore: A walking volcano with a short temper and a long, long fuse.

FROST_WYRM.name: Frost Wyrm
FROST_WYRM.lore: Its breath turns rivers to glass and hunters to statues.

ELDER_HOLLOW.name: Elder Hollow
ELDER_HOLLOW.lore: The oldest tree in the woods finally decided to walk. It is not happy.

STORM_TITAN.name: Storm Titan
STORM_TITAN.lore: Carries a thunderbolt like a walking stick. Never needed to walk.

IRON_JUGGERNAUT.name: Iron Juggernaut
IRON_JUGGERNAUT.lore: A siege engine that learned to march and forgot how to stop.

PHANTOM_PARADE.name: Phantom Parade
PHANTOM_PARADE.lore: A candle-lit procession of tiny ghosts. Everyone is invited. Nobody leaves.
